notes.title: Konami Confirms Post-Launch Release Window For Metal Gear Solid 3 Delta’s Multiplayer Mode
notes.notes:
Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater, the remake of Metal Gear Solid 3, is set to launch in just a few short weeks. But as already suspected, fans will have to wait a bit longer to play the game’s new online multiplayer mode, called Fox Hunt.

Konami has quietly said Fox Hunt will released after the game’s August 28 release date, with a current release window of Fall 2025. That detail didn’t come from any kind of official announcement, but a simple update on the website for the remake.

Fox Hunt is a brand-new mode for the remake, and not simply a remaster of the previous Metal Gear Online mode. The first look we had at the mode was back in June with a two-minute trailer that only gave us a very brief look at Fox Hunt.

But the site does at least give a bit of description on how Fox Hunt will utilize central elements of the base game, including “camouflage” and “survival.” Here’s what it says.

notes.title: Konami Releases Remade Version of Iconic Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater Opening
notes.notes:
Konami has released a full look at the remade version of Snake Eater, the iconic opening for Metal Gear Solid 3. Just like the original game, this version has been edited by Kyle Cooper with a brand-new recording of the theme song by Cynthia Harrell.

However, while it’s incredibly similar to the original, there are actually a few new scenes included in this opening. You can see the full video down below.

Metal Gear Solid Δ: Snake Eater is a remake of the original Metal Gears Solid 3, which first released on PlayStation 2 in 2005. Interestingly, however, this remake differs a little bit from what we typically see.

The original story and even the voice acting have been entirely untouched, while the visuals and gameplay have been reworked and modernized.

The remake features a new control scheme, although players can swap to the original one. At the same time, there’s a new third-person over-the-shoulder point on view, on top of the original overhead... Read more

notes.title: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater’s Release Date Leaked – And Konami Just Confirmed It
notes.notes:
Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater is officially launching on August 28, 2025, confirming long-standing leaks about its delay.

The upcoming remake of Metal Gear Solid 3, Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater, will arrive on August 28, 2025, according to a supposed PlayStation Store leak (which has since been updated), and shortly after the leak happened, Konami pulled back the curtain and released the trailer. What was once supposed to be released in 2024 has now officially moved into August 2025. The previously leaked footage showed the exact gameplay and trailer beats as the just released trailer by Konami. Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater is no stranger to leaks, as a prominent leaker suggested the title would be pushed to 2025 back in May 2024. The trailer can be seen below, courtesy of Konami.
